bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
pg=deploy-postgres-1
sql="SELECT column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='videobot_listings' ORDER BY ordinal_position;"
docker exec -e "SQL=$sql" "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -At -F "|" -c "$SQL"'
sql2="SELECT column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='videobot_post_receipts' ORDER BY ordinal_position;"
docker exec -e "SQL=$sql2" "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -At -F "|" -c "$SQL"'
